analysis.headline: Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang sued by shareholders over spy-affair scandal
analysis.summary: A law firm filed a class-action lawsuit and shareholders sued Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang, accusing them of misleading shareholders over the Chinese spying scandal, as the company's shares fell. The lawsuit news came as Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the CEO's links with Alice Huang.
